summary: When a range lower bound falls beyond the last key of a leaf, Node::path_next discards the ancestor path and returns an empty path, causing OrdMap::range to omit valid entries. The fix backtracks past exhausted ancestors to find the next available key. This reversal restores only the faulty path_next branch. The regression test added by the fix compares range counts against BTreeMap across a multilevel tree. No builds or tests were run.
